be opening land for millions to inhabit.
Not in total security, of course,
but safe enough, a life of free activity.
I see endless fields, vast and fruitful,
where man and beast alike will flock to live,
contented and at peace on the new-made land,
protected by the massive sheltering barrier
raised by the labor of a bold and fearless people.
Life in this interior will be a paradise,
while outside the sea may rage to the crest
of the mighty dam. And when the waters gnaw
and threaten to rush in through the masons’ work,
the people as one will rise to close the breach.
Yes!
To this philosophy I am wholly given,
wisdom can reach no further: He alone
is worthy of life and freedom who has to win them
by conquest every day. And so, ringed round
with danger, young and old will live a life
dedicated to vigorous activity.
Such a lusty throng I long to see,
and stand on free ground with a people free!
If this were so, I might say to the passing moment:
“Linger awhile, you are so fair!”
The traces of my days on earth can never—
no, not in eons—pass away.
In expectation of that highest bliss,
I now enjoy my greatest moment—this!
(浮士德 sinks back, the LEMURS seize him and lay him on the
ground.)

@@U04608@@
Pleasure never satisfied this man,
no bliss contented him,
and so he went on whoring after shifting forms.
translation:
@@U04606@@
开放土地供数百万人居住。
当然，并不是完全安全，
但足够安全，自由活动的生活。
我看到一望无际的田野，辽阔而硕果累累，
人和野兽都会聚集在那里居住，
在新的土地上感到满足和平静，
受到巨大防护屏障的保护
由勇敢无畏的人民的劳动抚养长大。
在这样的室内生活将是一个天堂，
而外面的大海可能会汹涌澎湃
强大的水坝。当海水侵蚀时
并威胁要闯入石匠的工作，
人民将团结起来，堵住缺口。
是的！
我完全相信这一哲学，
智慧无法更进一步：只有他
值得生命和自由的人必须赢得它们
每天都被征服。就这样，一圈一圈地
有危险，老少皆宜的生活
致力于剧烈的活动。
我渴望见到如此精力旺盛的人群，
与自由的人民一起站在自由的土地上！
如果是这样的话，我可能会对过去的时刻说：
“再呆会儿，你真公平！”
我在地球上的岁月痕迹永远无法——
不，不会在亿万年之后——逝去。
期盼那至高无上的幸福，
我现在享受着我最伟大的时刻——这个！
（浮士德向后退去，狐猴抓住他并把他放在地上
地。）

@@U04608@@
这个人永远无法满足快乐，
幸福没有满足他，
于是他在变换形态后继续嫖娼。
